| # clcan_fd_registerTxBuf {#clcan_fd_registertxbuf-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                                  |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Registers a transmit buffer for a CAN channel.

 

Remarks:

- Registering of transmit buffer is optional.

- There is no buffer available for transmitting CAN messages by default.

- A transmit buffer makes it easier to send a lot of CAN messages from the application because there is no need to wait.

- The buffer will be managed by CLAPI. The application has only to declare the buffer (memory space).

 

  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ![Attention](attention.png){style="margin:0;width:1.0938in;height:0.3542in;border:none"}   CAN Rx IDs: 18DA01FA/18DBFFFA and CAN Tx ID: 18DAFA01 shall not be used for CLAPI communication
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
